On veut répondre à une première question
Est ce que les imports sont une marge d'ajustement fce aux chocs d'offre


```{r}




colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_merge_CBF)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_merge_CBF))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "day_ahead_forecast_esp",  "unpredicted_renewables_esp", "intraday_update_renewables_esp",
  "day_ahead_forecast_fr",  "unpredicted_renewables_fr", "intraday_update_renewables_fr",
  "NTC_ESP_FR", "NTC_FR_ESP"
  
  )

price_merge_CBF[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_merge_CBF[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))

price_merge_CBF <-price_merge_CBF %>% 
  mutate(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES = as.numeric(SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES),
         SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR = as.numeric(SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR),
         SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES = as.numeric(SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES),
         SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR = as.numeric(SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR),
        SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES = SCH_EX_TOT_FR_ES - SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES ,
         SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR = SCH_EX_TOT_ES_FR - SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR,
        creneau = hour(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000))

price_merge_CBF$weekday <- weekdays(price_merge_CBF$delivery_date)

```
On cherche à savoir si les renouvelables et les indispos en France et en Espagne sont corrélés ?


```{r}
price_merge_CBF %>% 
  select(day_ahead_forecast_esp, unpredicted_renewables_esp, intraday_update_renewables_esp,
         day_ahead_forecast_fr, unpredicted_renewables_fr, intraday_update_renewables_fr) %>% 
  cor(use = "complete.obs")
```
On constate quelque chose de connu chez les électriciens.
Les renouvelables à l'échelle du continent sont corrolés de l'ordre de 60 %

On cherche à savoir si sur le marché intra daily,
on répond aux indispos et renouvelables par des imports

```{r}

import_data <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  select(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES, SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR, 
         SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES, SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR,
         year, month, weekday, creneau,
         cl_rf_id_esp , cl_rf_id_fr, 
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         day_ahead_forecast_esp, unpredicted_renewables_esp, intraday_update_renewables_esp,
         day_ahead_forecast_fr, unpredicted_renewables_fr, intraday_update_renewables_fr, datetime) %>% 
  na.omit()

m_ES_FR <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR ~ SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR+
                Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr,
                    data = import_data)

# Matrice de variance-covariance robuste à l'hétéroscédasticité avec clusters multiples
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_ES_FR, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)

cl_se_es_fr <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_FR_ES <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES ~ SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES +Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr,
                    data = import_data)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_FR_ES , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_fr_es <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))



m_ES_FR_FE <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR ~ SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR +
                   Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                   Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
                    data = import_data)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_ES_FR_FE , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)
cl_se_es_fr_fe <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_FR_ES_FE <- lm(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES~ SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES +Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                   Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+
                      Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+
                      day_ahead_forecast_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp+
                      day_ahead_forecast_fr + unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr+ 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
                    data = import_data)
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_FR_ES_FE , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_fr_es_fe <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


```

```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer( m_FR_ES,  m_FR_ES_FE, m_ES_FR, m_ES_FR_FE,
    type = "html",
    dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
    se = list(cl_se_fr_es, cl_se_fr_es_fe, cl_se_es_fr, cl_se_es_fr_fe),
    #se = list(cl_se_log, cl_se_log_FE, cl_se_control),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("FR -> ES",  "FR -> ES (with FE)", "ES -> FR", "ES -> FR (with FE)"),
    keep = c("Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp", "SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES", "SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR",
              "Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
             "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp",
                      "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr",
              "day_ahead_forecast_esp","unpredicted_renewables_esp", "intraday_update_renewables_esp",
                      "day_ahead_forecast_fr", "unpredicted_renewables_fr", "intraday_update_renewables_fr")
)
 
```

On a donc établi que les imports sont une marge d'ajustement face aux chocs d'offre
sur le marché intradaily




On regarde une transmission chocs de prix à l'étranger
Même regression que esp_day_ahead mais cette fois sur le prix de l'autre pays
On vérifie qu'en contrôlant par la différence de prix, ce lien disparaît

On considère d'abord l'effet des indispos + renouvelables (chocs d'offre) sur le prix en France

```{r}

import_data <- price_merge_CBF %>% 
  select(SCH_EX_Spread_FR_ES, SCH_EX_Spread_ES_FR, 
         SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES, SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR,
         NTC_ESP_FR, NTC_FR_ESP,
         price_fr, price_esp,
         cl_rf_id_esp, cl_rf_id_fr,
         gen_tot_esp, gen_tot_fr,
         year, month, weekday, creneau,
         spot_gas_esp ,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp,
         Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr,
         day_ahead_forecast_esp, unpredicted_renewables_esp, intraday_update_renewables_esp,
         day_ahead_forecast_fr, unpredicted_renewables_fr, intraday_update_renewables_fr, datetime) %>% 
  mutate(price_diff_fr_esp = price_fr - price_esp,
         #contrary to CBF I allow for negative CBF
         # with the convention that ESP to FR is >0
         CBF_DA = SCH_EX_DA_ES_FR - SCH_EX_DA_FR_ES
         ) %>%
  na.omit()

import_data_reg <- import_data %>% 
  filter(is.finite(log(price_esp)) & is.finite(log(price_fr)))



import_data_reg <- import_data_reg[complete.cases(import_data_reg),]
import_data_reg <- import_data_reg[!rowSums(sapply(import_data_reg, is.infinite)), ]


# perform first stage regression
m_rf <- lm(
  log(price_esp) ~ Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+  
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + 
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + 
     gen_tot_esp + gen_tot_fr + day_ahead_forecast_esp ,
  data= import_data_reg)


vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)
cl_se_rf_esp <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_rf_FE <- lm(
  log(price_esp) ~ Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+ 
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + 
    gen_tot_esp + gen_tot_fr + day_ahead_forecast_esp +
    spot_gas_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data=import_data_reg)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_FE , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_FE <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_rf_control <- lm(
  log(price_esp) ~ Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+ 
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + 
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_esp + 
    Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+ 
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr +
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr+ 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity_fr + 
    gen_tot_esp + gen_tot_fr + day_ahead_forecast_esp + day_ahead_forecast_fr+
    spot_gas_esp + unpredicted_renewables_esp + intraday_update_renewables_esp +
    unpredicted_renewables_fr + intraday_update_renewables_fr +
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= import_data_reg)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_control  , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id_esp + cl_rf_id_fr)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_control <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


```



```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer( m_rf, m_rf_FE, m_rf_control, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_rf_esp, cl_se_rf_FE, cl_se_rf_control),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "+ Controls"),
    keep = c(".Capacity", "gen_tot",
             "day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables")
)
 
```

On cherche à montrer que la NTC a un pouvoir prédictif que l'on pourrit également utiliser comme instrument
Dans les cas où c'est saturé soit 60 % du temps,
impose une limite à la quantité exportée, donc possiblement au prix


```{r}

# perform first stage regression

m_ntc_es <- lm(
```

I have shown effects, but I would like to increase the prediction abilities of my model by considering the non-linear features (especially saturation with the NTC threshold)


```{r}
library(mgcv)

import_data_reg$flow_sign <- ifelse(import_data_reg$CBF_DA >= 0, "pos", "neg")

m_gam_sign <- gam(
  CBF_DA ~ 
    s(NTC_ESP_FR, by = as.factor(flow_sign)) + 
    s(NTC_FR_ESP, by = as.factor(flow_sign)) +
    s(gen_tot_esp) + s(gen_tot_fr) + 
    s(day_ahead_forecast_esp) + s(day_ahead_forecast_fr) +
    spot_gas_esp +
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data = import_data_reg
)

```

Assess the performances of the models


```{r}
# Plot GAM smooth terms
plot(m_gam_sign, pages = 1, se = TRUE, main = "GAM Smooth Effects")

# Check model diagnostics (residuals, QQ-plot, etc.)
gam.check(m_gam_sign)

# Predict on the original dataset
import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_gam <- predict(m_gam_sign, newdata = import_data_reg)

# Plot predicted vs actual
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(import_data_reg, aes(x = CBF_DA, y = CBF_DA_pred_gam)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Actual (GAM)", x = "Actual CBF_DA", y = "Predicted CBF_DA") +
  theme_minimal()

```







```{r}
library(Metrics)

import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_lin <- predict(m_cbf_pred_NTC, newdata = import_data_reg)
 
import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated <- predict(m_cbf_pred_no_NTC, newdata = import_data_reg)
import_data_reg <- import_data_reg %>% 
  mutate(CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated = ifelse(CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated > 1000*NTC_ESP_FR, 
                                            1000*NTC_ESP_FR, CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated),
         CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated = ifelse(CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated < -1000*NTC_FR_ESP,
                                            -1000*NTC_FR_ESP, CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated))

rmse_gam <- rmse(import_data_reg$CBF_DA, import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_gam)
#rmse_surv <- rmse(import_data_reg$CBF_DA, import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_surv*10**6)
rmse_lin <- rmse(import_data_reg$CBF_DA, import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_lin)
rmse_lin_saturated <- rmse(import_data_reg$CBF_DA, import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated)

cat("RMSE GAM:", rmse_gam, "\n")
#cat("RMSE Interval Regression:", rmse_surv, "\n")
cat("RMSE Linear Regression:", rmse_lin, "\n")
cat("RMSE Linear Regression (saturated):", rmse_lin_saturated, "\n")

# Predicted values (already calculated earlier)
pred <- import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_gam
obs <- import_data_reg$CBF_DA

# Compute R² manually
r2_gam <- 1 - sum((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((obs - mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Pseudo R² (based on gam predictions):", round(r2_gam, 4), "\n")
# Compute R² for linear regression
r2_lin <- summary(m_cbf_pred_NTC)$r.squared

cat("R² Linear model:", round(r2_lin, 4), "\n")


# Compute R² for linear regression with saturation
r2_lin_saturated <- 1 - sum((import_data_reg$CBF_DA - import_data_reg$CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated)^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
  sum((import_data_reg$CBF_DA - mean(import_data_reg$CBF_DA, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("R² Linear model (saturated):", round(r2_lin_saturated, 4), "\n")

```

Se rendre compte de l'erreur à l'échelle mensuelle

```{r}
#colnames(import_data_reg)
import_data_reg_monthly <- import_data_reg %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  summarise(CBF_DA = mean(CBF_DA, na.rm = TRUE),
            CBF_DA_pred_gam = mean(CBF_DA_pred_gam, na.rm = TRUE),
            CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated = mean(CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated, na.rm = TRUE),
            Date = as.Date(paste0(year, '-', month, '-01'))) %>% 
  ungroup()

ggplot(import_data_reg_monthly, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = CBF_DA, color = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = CBF_DA_pred_gam, color = "GAM Predicted")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = CBF_DA_pred_lin_saturated, color = "Linear Predicted")) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Average CBF_DA vs Predictions",
       x = "Date", y = "CBF_DA") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", "GAM Predicted" = "blue",
                                "Linear Predicted" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# Remove NA to ensure consistency
monthly_df <- import_data_reg_monthly %>%
```
